property_summary: For every call to C.transfer with a non-empty _tos array, the reference contract reverts the whole call if any callee reverts (so the call cannot complete successfully when a callee fails); the mutant that drops the require(_s) can complete successfully (return true) even when a callee reverts, so there exist inputs where reference reverts but mutant returns true.
change_summary: Remove the inner require(_s) so failed external calls no longer revert; transfer will return true even if some calls fail (observable by return value difference).
